Hi all — quick technical note and the pinned invite attached.

Root cause: Calendly and many scheduler widgets default to the timezone reported by the browser/device. When a participant is traveling and has multiple devices (phone on local carrier, laptop set to home timezone), the scheduler can show the correct-looking local time but create an .ics in a different offset. Also some calendar apps will interpret an ambiguous hour differently during DST transitions.

Workaround we used here:
1) I generated a small .ics that explicitly sets DTSTART and TZID to Europe/Paris — that forces the event to appear at the same local hour for everyone viewing as Europe/Paris. (Attached as proposed_slots.ics)
2) For prospects booking themselves, add a one-line instruction under the Calendly widget: "If you are traveling, please confirm the timezone shown in the bottom-right before booking. If unsure, pick a UTC slot or reply to this email and we'll send an invite pinned to your desired timezone."
3) For Chili Piper customers: recommend the "force-ics" fallback which produces the same effect when auto-detect is ambiguous.

I've attached a single-slot .ics set to 2028-05-03 11:00 Europe/Paris — Irene, if that works for you, please send it to Josh and mark as tentative until he confirms. Josh — once you accept the attached invite it should show at 11:00 Paris time on your main calendar regardless of the device you accept with.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
